records.text: Candace Owens said Elizabeth McCoy recorded Erika Kirk leaning over Charlie Kirk's open casket in Utah the day before Erika posted the footage on September 12.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: On September 12th—okay, so the day after that—Charlie (Charlie Kirk) is back in Phoenix at Hansen Mortuary, and Erika (Erika Kirk) moves to post the footage that Elizabeth McCoy... actually captured the day before in Utah. verification.notes: The episode asserts that Elizabeth McCoy recorded Erika Kirk with the open casket in Utah on September 11 and that Erika posted it September 12. Current reporting confirms Erika shared open-casket imagery on September 12 and confirms the casket was transported from Utah to Phoenix on September 11, but the opened sources do not independently identify Elizabeth McCoy as the recorder or establish when and where that footage was captured. The precise compound claim is therefore attempted/unverifiable.
